mainEntity.name: How does Splitly calculate group balances?

acceptedAnswer.text: Splitly automatically totals all individual expenses and minimizes payments so your group only needs to make the fewest possible direct repayments.

mainEntity.name: Is my financial expense data stored on a central server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Splitly saves your trip data directly on your device. You never need to sign up, log in, or share passwords.

mainEntity.name: How do temporary trip share links work?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you generate a share link, a temporary copy of your trip is encrypted for 24 hours. Friends can import the trip to their device, after which the link automatically self-destructs.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Splitly without an internet connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! You can add Splitly to your phone's home screen with 1 tap. It works 100% offline wherever you go.
